{{Quote|I am Pashon Cortess, scion of House Cortess and heir to Baron Peyar, Sword of the Castle Lands of Alderaan.|Pashon Cortess|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Pashon Cortess''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was the son of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Peyar Cortess]] and [[Chay Cortess]] and a member of [[House Cortess]]. Around [[3641 BBY]] he received information from [[Hunter (Star Cabal)|Hunter]] on the whereabouts of [[Cipher Nine]] and vowed to kill them for "ruining" his family's prestige. He approached the [[Agent/Legends|agent]] on [[Proculus Station]], but was outmatched. Before passing out, he told the agent that Nine's other victims would come to seek their vengeance.
{{GameDS}}
Imperial security then arrived, astounded at having been duped by Pashon, as he arrived claiming authorization from [[House of Thul|House Thul]] and ask Cipher as to Pashon's fate, with the agent ordering him executed.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Pashon Cortess is a character in the 2011 ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' video game, appearing in the Imperial Agent Chapter 3 quest "Heist."

If [[Vector Hyllus]] is the player's companion, there will be special dialogue, in which Vector attempts to talk down Pashon but this has no effect on avoiding a fight.

Depending on the player's choices, Pashon's fate is decided three ways:
*Pashon is imprisoned (neutral dialogue)
*Pashon is sent to House Thul (light side dialogue)
*Pashon is executed (dark side dialogue)
